review.gallery: Nine original brochure renders and one October 2026 construction photograph. Nearby buildings seen behind foundation works are not presented as completed Playa Del Sol residences.
review.location: The Ellington sales listing publishes the adopted point. Thirteen times match the project brief. Wynn Resorts still described the destination as planned in its November 2026 third-quarter release.
review.floorPlans: Twenty-three selectable drawings. The detailed 3 BR Type A sheet and developer availability list give 1,906.50 sq ft. The project brief prints 1,906.53 for the same components. The detailed villa drawing prints 8,673.77 against 8,524.69 in the launch summary. The basement appears in the original three-level design overview. The duplicated Type B sheet in the project brief is represented once.

unavailable: A separate orthographic villa basement drawing, building basement plates, surveyed visitor entrance and verified completed project photography.
